name: Copy.ai
summary: AI platform for sales and marketing content.

flows.title: Start a chat project
steps: Click the + button in the left navigation bar, or New chat on the homepage inside your Teamspace.
Name the Chat Project in the top left — that name is how you find it under Projects later.
Choose the language model from the dropdown in the top right. It can be changed at any point in the conversation.
Type in the chat window and press the arrow icon on the right, or Enter, to send.

Click Attach to upload a document; it goes into your Teamspace's Infobase, so this chat and later ones can use it. Prompts in the bottom left opens a library of ready-made prompts, and Improve rewrites a first draft of a prompt into a fuller one.

flows.title: Keep chat projects in folders
steps: Click Projects in the left-hand navigation menu. The page lists your folders and, below them, the projects that are not in one.
Tick the checkbox on one or more projects.
Select the folder they should go to.

flows.title: Tag Infobase entries and pull them into a prompt
steps: While creating a new Infobase entry, or editing one, click Add Tags in the sidebar.
Type the tag's name in the search box and click Create [#tagname].
In Chat or a Workflow, type # followed by the name of the Infobase entry or the tag.
A tag searches Infobase for every entry carrying it, finds the most relevant snippets and hands that context to the AI.
